nodes.name: Daily 07:00 CT
nodes.notes: Generates Hiros daily briefing. Aggregates: (a) sequence activity yesterday, (b) Calendly bookings next 48h, (c) unanswered leads >24h, (d) Bentley n8n-monitor flags. DMs result to Hiro via Bentley HTTP.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Last 24h Activity
nodes.notes: Uses raw HubSpot HTTP rather than the typed node so we can do date-math filtering. Alternative: lib/find-hubspot-contacts-modified-since.json sub-workflow.

parameters.name: instructions
parameters.value: Write Hiros morning briefing in the SOUL.md voice. Max 250 words. Lead with what changed since yesterday, then anything that needs his decision today, then a one-line motivational close. No bullet points unless absolutely needed - this reads on Telegram.

nodes.name: Bentley: Write Briefing
nodes.notes: Path B hybrid: n8n gathers stats, Bentley writes the prose with brand voice.

nodes.name: Telegram: DM Hiro
nodes.notes: Direct Telegram send bypasses Bentley for delivery. Alternative if you do not want n8n to hold the bot token: route through Bentley with skill=send-telegram - keeps the token in one place.
